text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин comes out on top at the
Japanese
Derby, but she collapses from
sheer exhaustion
after the fierce race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Бива Хаяхидэ visit
her
afterward and are relieved to see
that she's okay.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They each declare their intent to win the
final
race in the Triple Crown tour—the
Kikuka
Sho—and depart from the room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Бива Хаяхидэ's

overwhelming determination leaves
Нарита Таисин
in awe.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
